tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Not later than 1 year after November 7, 2000, the Council, 1 shall develop an estuary habitat restoration strategy designed to ensure a comprehensive approach to maximize benefits derived from estuary habitat restoration projects and to foster the coordination of Federal and non-Federal activities related to restoration of estuary habitat.

tree.heading: Goal
tree.text: The goal of the strategy shall be the restoration of 1,000,000 acres of estuary habitat by the year 2010.

tree.heading: Integration of estuary habitat restoration plans, programs, and partnerships
tree.text: In developing the estuary habitat restoration strategy, the Council shall—

children.text: conduct a review of estuary management or habitat restoration plans and Federal programs established under other laws that authorize funding for estuary habitat restoration activities; and
ensure that the estuary habitat restoration strategy is developed in a manner that is consistent with the estuary management or habitat restoration plans.

tree.heading: Elements of the strategy
tree.text: The estuary habitat restoration strategy shall include proposals, methods, and guidance on—

children.text: maximizing the incentives for the creation of new public-private partnerships to carry out estuary habitat restoration projects and the use of Federal resources to encourage increased private sector involvement in estuary habitat restoration activities;
ensuring that the estuary habitat restoration strategy will be implemented in a manner that is consistent with the estuary management or habitat restoration plans;
promoting estuary habitat restoration projects to—
provide healthy ecosystems in order to support—
wildlife, including endangered and threatened species, migratory birds, and resident species of an estuary watershed; and
fish and shellfish, including commercial and recreational fisheries;
improve surface and ground water quality and quantity, and flood control;
address other areas of concern that the Council determines to be appropriate for consideration;
addressing the estimated historic losses, estimated current rate of loss, and extent of the threat of future loss or degradation of each type of estuary habitat;
measuring the rate of change for each type of estuary habitat;
selecting a balance of smaller and larger estuary habitat restoration projects; and
ensuring equitable geographic distribution of projects funded under this chapter.

tree.heading: Public review and comment
tree.text: Before the Council adopts a final or revised estuary habitat restoration strategy, the Secretary shall publish in the Federal Register a draft of the estuary habitat restoration strategy and provide an opportunity for public review and comment.

tree.heading: Periodic revision
tree.text: Using data and information developed through project monitoring and management, and other relevant information, the Council may periodically review and update, as necessary, the estuary habitat restoration strategy.
